battle.abilities.smoke_bomb.description.en: Throw it over your warriors as they walk into a defense's range. For 8 seconds, warriors inside the cloud can only be shot from close up (Night Blades also hit buildings inside it twice as hard).
battle.abilities.smoke_bomb.description.text: Liphonse phezu kwamaqhawe akho lapho engena ebangeni lesivikelo. Imizuzwana engu-8, amaqhawe angaphakathi efwini angadutshulwa kuphela eduze (Izinkemba Zasebusuku nazo zishaya izakhiwo ezingaphakathi kwalo ngamandla aphindwe kabili).

battle.heroes.shadow_captain.description.en: Clan hero. On his first strike he rallies nearby warriors: 30% more damage for 8 seconds, once per battle.
battle.heroes.shadow_captain.description.text: Umpetha wesizwe. Ekushayeni kwakhe kokuqala uqoqa amaqhawe aseduze: umonakalo ongu-30% owengeziwe imizuzwana engu-8, kanye ngempi.

buildings.elder_toadstool.description.en: The hidden heart of your clan. Upgrade it to unlock new buildings, warriors and higher levels.
buildings.elder_toadstool.description.text: Inhliziyo efihlekile yesizwe sakho. Yithuthukise ukuze uvule izakhiwo ezintsha, amaqhawe namazinga aphezulu.

buildings.acorn_orchard.description.en: Artisans stamp fresh Coins every hour. Holds 8 hours of output, so collect often.
buildings.acorn_orchard.description.text: Izingcweti zishaya izinhlamvu ezintsha njalo ngehora. Sigcina umkhiqizo wamahora angu-8, ngakho qoqa njalo.

buildings.dewdrop_well.description.en: Terraced fields that grow Provisions for your warriors. Holds 8 hours of output.
buildings.dewdrop_well.description.text: Amasimu anezitebhisi atshala ukudla kwamaqhawe akho. Igcina umkhiqizo wamahora angu-8.

buildings.acorn_silo.description.en: A locked vault for your Coins. Bigger treasuries let you save for bigger upgrades.
buildings.acorn_silo.description.text: Igumbi elikhiyiwe lezinhlamvu zakho. Izikhwama ezinkulu zikuvumela ukonga ukuthuthukisa okukhulu.

buildings.dew_cistern.description.en: Stores Provisions for your warriors. Raiders can only carry off part of what is inside.
buildings.dew_cistern.description.text: Igcina ukudla kwamaqhawe akho. Abagaseli bangathwala kuphela ingxenye yalokho okungaphakathi.

buildings.beaver_lodge.description.en: Home of a Village Artisan. Each hut lets you build or upgrade one thing at a time.
buildings.beaver_lodge.description.text: Ikhaya Lengcweti Yesigodi. Iqhugwane ngalinye likuvumela ukwakha noma ukuthuthukisa into eyodwa ngesikhathi.

buildings.burrow_barracks.description.en: Trains warriors and studies battle scrolls to make them stronger. Higher levels unlock new warriors.
buildings.burrow_barracks.description.text: Liqeqesha amaqhawe futhi lifunde imiqulu yempi ukuze liwenze abe namandla. Amazinga aphezulu avula amaqhawe amasha.

buildings.army_camp.description.en: Where trained warriors wait for the next raid. Each level houses more.
buildings.army_camp.description.text: Lapho amaqhawe aqeqeshiwe elinda ukugasela okulandelayo. Izinga ngalinye lihlalisa amaningi.

buildings.acorn_cannon.description.en: A lookout that throws volleys of kunai at warriors on the ground. Cannot hit flyers.
buildings.acorn_cannon.description.text: Umbhoshongo wokulinda ojikijela ama-kunai kumaqhawe asemhlabathini. Awukwazi ukushaya abandizayo.

buildings.pinecone_catapult.description.en: Launches bursting fireworks that splash groups of warriors on the ground. Slow, and blind to warriors right beside it.
buildings.pinecone_catapult.description.text: Idubula iziqhumane eziqhumayo ezisabalala emaqenjini amaqhawe asemhlabathini. Ihamba kancane, futhi ayiwaboni amaqhawe aseduze kwayo.

buildings.wasp_nest.description.en: Spinning shuriken strike warriors on the ground and in the air.
buildings.wasp_nest.description.text: Ama-shuriken azungezayo ashaya amaqhawe asemhlabathini nasemoyeni.

buildings.firefly_tower.description.en: Archers with great bows that hit flying warriors hard. Ignores warriors on the ground.
buildings.firefly_tower.description.text: Abacibishelayo abanemicibisholo emikhulu abashaya kakhulu amaqhawe andizayo. Awanaki amaqhawe asemhlabathini.

buildings.bramble_hedge.description.en: Fitted mountain stone. Warriors walk around it or break through it. Higher levels add iron-banded gates. Builds instantly.
buildings.bramble_hedge.description.text: Itshe lasentabeni elihlanganiswe kahle. Amaqhawe ayaluzungeza noma aluqhekeze. Amazinga aphezulu engeza amasango aboshwe ngensimbi. Lwakhiwa ngokushesha.

buildings.thorn_snare.description.en: A hidden pit of bamboo spikes that springs when warriors on the ground step close. Unseen until it goes off.
buildings.thorn_snare.description.text: Umgodi ofihlekile wezikhonkwane zoqalo oqhuma lapho amaqhawe asemhlabathini esondela. Awubonakali uze uqhume.

buildings.sap_puddle.description.en: Hidden iron caltrops that slow warriors on the ground to half speed for a few seconds.
buildings.sap_puddle.description.text: Izipikili zensimbi ezifihlekile ezehlisa ijubane lamaqhawe asemhlabathini libe yingxenye imizuzwana embalwa.

buildings.flower_bed.description.en: A carefully shaped little pine. Purely decorative.
buildings.flower_bed.description.text: Uphayini omncane ololongwe ngokucophelela. Owokuhlobisa kuphela.

buildings.lantern_post.description.en: A carved stone lantern that glows through the night. Purely decorative.
buildings.lantern_post.description.text: Ilambu letshe elibaziwe elikhanya ubusuku bonke. Elokuhlobisa kuphela.

buildings.mushroom_ring.description.en: Raked gravel and three quiet stones. Purely decorative.
buildings.mushroom_ring.description.text: Amatshana ahlwathiwe namatshe amathathu athule. Eyokuhlobisa kuphela.

buildings.mossy_statue.description.en: A weathered stone sentinel that watches the gate. Purely decorative.
buildings.mossy_statue.description.text: Umlindi wetshe oguguleke ngesimo sezulu obheke isango. Owokuhlobisa kuphela.

buildings.obstacle_bush.description.en: Clear it to make room. You might find Jade!
buildings.obstacle_bush.description.text: Lisuse ukuze wenze indawo. Ungathola ijeyidi!

buildings.obstacle_stump.description.en: Clear it to make room. You might find Jade!
buildings.obstacle_stump.description.text: Wususe ukuze wenze indawo. Ungathola ijeyidi!

buildings.obstacle_rock.description.en: Clear it to make room. You might find Jade!
buildings.obstacle_rock.description.text: Lisuse ukuze wenze indawo. Ungathola ijeyidi!

buildings.grove_lodge.description.en: Your link to your Alliance. Holds the warriors your allies send you, ready for your next raid.
buildings.grove_lodge.description.text: Ukuxhumana kwakho noMfelandawonye wakho. Igcina amaqhawe ozakwenu abakuthumelela wona, alungele ukugasela kwakho okulandelayo.

buildings.paper_lantern_line.description.en: Lanterns strung low between posts. Hidden or mist-veiled ground warriors within 2 tiles are lit up for a few seconds: defenses can see them, and lit warriors take extra damage. Once it has lit someone, the line itself is no longer hidden.
buildings.paper_lantern_line.description.text: Amalambu alengiswe phansi phakathi kwezigxobo. Amaqhawe asemhlabathini afihlekile noma embozwe yinkungu angaphakathi kwamathayela angu-2 ayakhanyiswa imizuzwana embalwa: izivikelo ziyawabona, futhi amaqhawe akhanyisiwe athola umonakalo owengeziwe. Uma usukhanyise othile, umugqa uqobo awusafihlekile.

buildings.clockwork_repairer.description.en: A mechanic's crane that reaches over nearby defenses: jams, stuns and a Hawk Tamer's slowing on defenses within 3 tiles are cut short. A few repairs per battle.
buildings.clockwork_repairer.description.text: Ikhreyini kamakhenikha efinyelela phezu kwezivikelo eziseduze: ukumiswa, ukudidizeliswa nokwehliswa ijubane nguMfuyi Wezinkozi ezivikelweni ezingaphakathi kwamathayela angu-3 kuyanqanyulwa. Ukulungisa okumbalwa ngempi ngayinye.

buildings.bitter_incense_burner.descript.en: Burns bitter herbs: warriors within 3 tiles receive less healing, and healing, haste and toughness auras and shelter shields work at reduced strength on them.
buildings.bitter_incense_burner.descript.text: Sishisa amakhambi ababayo: amaqhawe angaphakathi kwamathayela angu-3 athola ukwelashwa okuncane, futhi izinsizakuqinisa zokwelapha, ijubane nokuqina kanye nezihlangu zokukhosela zisebenza ngamandla ancishisiwe kuwo.

buildings.kite_cutter_ballista.descripti.en: Air only. Fires a spinning bolas that tangles anything with wings or strings: a flyer it hits is grounded for 3 seconds, where ground defenses can reach it. A flyer that breaks free can't be tangled again for 3 seconds.
buildings.kite_cutter_ballista.descripti.text: Emoyeni kuphela. Sidubula intambo enamatshe ezungezayo ethandela noma yini enamaphiko noma izintambo: indizayo eshaywe yiyo yehliselwa phansi imizuzwana engu-3, lapho izivikelo zasemhlabathini zingayifinyelela. Indizayo ezikhululayo ayinakuthandelwa futhi imizuzwana engu-3.

buildings.longbow_yagura.description.en: A tall archery tower with range 13 that outranges every siege warrior. It prefers warriors attacking from 3.5 tiles or more (throwers and artillery), but cannot hit anything closer than 2 tiles.
buildings.longbow_yagura.description.text: Umbhoshongo omude wokucibishela onebanga elingu-13 elidlula lawo wonke amaqhawe okuvimbezela. Ikhetha amaqhawe ahlasela kusukela kumathayela angu-3.5 noma ngaphezulu (abajikijeli nezibhamu ezinkulu), kodwa ayikwazi ukushaya noma yini esondele ngaphansi kwamathayela angu-2.

events.schedule.harvest_moon.description.en: Collecting from Coin Mints and Terraced Farms gives 30% extra.
events.schedule.harvest_moon.description.text: Ukuqoqa ezigayweni zezinhlamvu nasemasimini anezitebhisi kunika okungu-30% okwengeziwe.

events.schedule.raiders_moon.description.text: Ukuhlasela okunqotshiwe kuletha impango engu-20% eyengeziwe.

events.schedule.swift_paws.description.text: Ukuqeqesha amaqhawe kubiza ukudla okuncane ngo-25%.

events.schedule.bounty_hunt.description.en: A rival warlord's fortress has a bounty on it. Attack it as often as you like while the hunt lasts: each mark on the reward ladder pays once.
events.schedule.bounty_hunt.description.text: Inqaba yenkosi yempi eyimbangi inomvuzo. Yihlasele kaningi ngendlela othanda ngayo ngenkathi ukuzingela kuqhubeka: uphawu ngalunye esitebhisini semiklomelo lukhokha kanye.

events.schedule.raiders_moon_2.descripti.text: Ukuhlasela okunqotshiwe kuletha impango engu-20% eyengeziwe.

names.rivalClans.crimson_lotus.bio.en: A river clan that trades in secrets. Akane never fights where she can be seen; her outposts lean on traps and mortars.
names.rivalClans.crimson_lotus.bio.text: Isizwe sasemfuleni esihweba ngezimfihlo. U-Akane akalwi lapho engabonwa khona; izikhungo zakhe zithembele ezicuphweni nasezinganonweni.

names.rivalClans.iron_tide.bio.en: Salt-hardened raiders from the coast. Gorō builds thick walls and dares you to break them.
names.rivalClans.iron_tide.bio.text: Abagaseli abaqiniswe usawoti abavela ogwini. UGorō wakha izindonga eziqinile futhi akuphonsela inselelo yokuziqhekeza.

names.rivalClans.moon_veil.bio.en: Mountain hermits who see in the dark. Yoru spreads her towers wide so no path is safe.
names.rivalClans.moon_veil.bio.text: Izazi zasentabeni ezibona ebumnyameni. UYoru usabalalisa imibhoshongo yakhe kabanzi ukuze kungabikho ndlela ephephile.

notifications.types.gangWar.label.en: Gang War found, battle day, 2 hours left, relay turn, under attack (online)
notifications.types.gangWar.label.text: Impi Yamaviyo itholakele, usuku lwempi, kusele amahora angu-2, ithuba lokudluliselana, kuhlaselwa (ku-inthanethi)

notifications.types.friends.label.en: Friend requests, duels and duel challenges (online)

offers.rules.starter_pack.description.en: A one-time boost for new clan leaders: Jade and resources to speed things up.
offers.rules.starter_pack.description.text: Usizo lwakanye kubaholi abasha besizwe: ijeyidi nezinsiza zokusheshisa izinto.

offers.rules.builder_pack.description.en: Jade to hire another Village Artisan, plus a little extra.
offers.rules.builder_pack.description.text: Ijeyidi lokuqasha enye Ingcweti Yesigodi, kanye nokunye okuncane okwengeziwe.

offers.rules.war_prep_pack.description.en: Get ready for the Alliance War: Provisions for your warriors, and Jade.
offers.rules.war_prep_pack.description.text: Lungela Impi Yomfelandawonye: ukudla kwamaqhawe akho, nejeyidi.

offers.rules.keep_pack.description.en: Your Keep grew. Supplies sized for your new Keep level, and Jade.
offers.rules.keep_pack.description.text: Inqaba yakho ikhulile. Izimpahla ezilingene izinga lenqaba yakho elisha, nejeyidi.

offers.rules.rebuild_pack.description.en: Raiders hit hard. Restock your storage.
offers.rules.rebuild_pack.description.text: Abagaseli bashaye kanzima. Gcwalisa kabusha iziphala zakho.

pass.weeklyChallenges.w_destruction.text.en: Destroy {n}% in raids this week (added up)

pass.weeklyChallenges.w_trials.text.en: Clear {n} new Shadow Trial tiers this week
pass.weeklyChallenges.w_trials.text.text: Qeda amazinga amasha angu-{n} Ezivivinyo Zesithunzi kuleli sonto

progression.roles.blade.summary.en: Fast melee that strikes the nearest building.
progression.roles.blade.summary.text: Umlwi osheshayo oseduze oshaya isakhiwo esiseduze kakhulu.

progression.roles.thrower.summary.en: Fragile ranged damage from behind the front line.
progression.roles.thrower.summary.text: Umonakalo wasebangeni obuthakathaka ovela ngemuva komugqa wangaphambili.

progression.roles.guardian.summary.en: Armored frontliner that walks into defenses and soaks fire.
progression.roles.guardian.summary.text: Umlwi wangaphambili onezembatho zensimbi ongena ezivikelweni futhi amunce umlilo.

progression.roles.saboteur.summary.en: Specialist that disables defenses for a short time.

progression.roles.infiltrator.summary.en: Gets past walls by tunnel, rope or rooftop.
progression.roles.infiltrator.summary.text: Udlula izindonga ngomhubhe, ngentambo noma ngophahla.

progression.roles.sky.summary.en: Flies over everything; only anti-air can touch it, so it is fragile and hits lighter.
progression.roles.sky.summary.text: Undiza phezu kwakho konke; izivikelo zasemoyeni kuphela ezingamthinta, ngakho buthakathaka futhi ushaya kancane.

progression.roles.mystic.summary.en: Supports nearby warriors: heals, haste, shields.
progression.roles.mystic.summary.text: Usekela amaqhawe aseduze: ukwelapha, ijubane, izihlangu.

progression.roles.siege.summary.en: Breaks walls and buildings fast; weak against defenses.
progression.roles.siege.summary.text: Uqhekeza izindonga nezakhiwo ngokushesha; buthakathaka ezivikelweni.

progression.roles.beast.summary.en: Handlers and their animals: numbers and charges.
progression.roles.beast.summary.text: Abafuyi nezilwane zabo: ubuningi nokugijima ngamandla.

progression.buildingCatalog.scroll_libra.en: Moves warrior research out of the Training Dojo and studies mastery scrolls.
progression.buildingCatalog.scroll_libra.text: Ususa ucwaningo lwamaqhawe e-Idojo Lokuqeqesha futhi ufunde imiqulu yobungcweti.

progression.buildingCatalog.shadow_ink_w.en: Distils Shadow Ink, the third currency, used for Veteran-tier warriors and heroes.
progression.buildingCatalog.shadow_ink_w.text: Ucwenga uyinki wesithunzi, imali yesithathu, esetshenziselwa amaqhawe ezinga Longqondongqondo nompetha.

progression.buildingCatalog.reinforced_g.en: A wall segment with an iron-banded gate; tougher than stone and opens only for defenders.
progression.buildingCatalog.reinforced_g.text: Ingxenye yodonga enesango eliboshwe ngensimbi; liqinile kunetshe futhi livulekela abavikeli kuphela.

progression.buildingCatalog.sky_net.desc.en: Hidden net that snares flyers for a few seconds.
progression.buildingCatalog.sky_net.desc.text: Inetha elifihlekile elibamba abandizayo imizuzwana embalwa.

progression.buildingCatalog.hero_shrine..en: Home of a clan hero; one hall per hero.
progression.buildingCatalog.hero_shrine..text: Ikhaya lompetha wesizwe; ihholo elilodwa kumpetha ngamunye.

progression.buildingCatalog.temple_bell_.en: Rings when warriors approach: reveals Shadow warriors and halves smoke duration nearby.
progression.buildingCatalog.temple_bell_.text: Iyakhala lapho amaqhawe esondela: idalula amaqhawe esiThunzi futhi inciphise isikhathi sentuthu sibe yingxenye eduze.

progression.buildingCatalog.clan_forge.d.en: Forges equipment that adds small bonuses to one role at a time.
progression.buildingCatalog.clan_forge.d.text: Sakha imishini engeza amabhonasi amancane endimeni eyodwa ngesikhathi.

progression.buildingCatalog.wind_chime_w.en: Tripwire that slows and reveals everything that crosses it.
progression.buildingCatalog.wind_chime_w.text: Ucingo lokukhubeka olwehlisa ijubane futhi lwembule konke okuluweqayo.

progression.buildingCatalog.crossbow_bas.en: Fires at three targets at once.

progression.buildingCatalog.flame_trench.en: A trench that bursts into flame under warriors on the ground.
progression.buildingCatalog.flame_trench.text: Umsele ovutha amalangabi ngaphansi kwamaqhawe asemhlabathini.

progression.buildingCatalog.thunder_shri.en: Chain lightning that jumps between flyers.

progression.buildingCatalog.ninja_watch_.en: Sends out defending ninja who chase attackers.

progression.buildingCatalog.great_dragon.en: The keep's last word: enormous damage, very slow.
progression.buildingCatalog.great_dragon.text: Izwi lokugcina lenqaba: umonakalo omkhulu kakhulu, ihamba kancane kakhulu.

progression.buildingCatalog.whirling_bla.en: Short-range spinning blades hit every ground warrior within 1.2 tiles. Punishes cheap melee swarms; useless against anything that stands back.
progression.buildingCatalog.whirling_bla.text: Izinkemba ezizungezayo zebanga elifushane zishaya wonke amaqhawe asemhlabathini angaphakathi kwamathayela angu-1.2. Ijezisa izixuku zabalwi abaseduze abashibhile; ayisizi ngalutho kulokho okuma kude.

progression.buildingCatalog.paper_lanter.en: Lanterns strung low between posts. Hidden or mist-veiled ground warriors within 2 tiles are lit up for a few seconds: defenses can see them, and lit warriors take extra damage. Once it has lit someone, the line itself is no longer hidden.
progression.buildingCatalog.paper_lanter.text: Amalambu alengiswe phansi phakathi kwezigxobo. Amaqhawe asemhlabathini afihlekile noma embozwe yinkungu angaphakathi kwamathayela angu-2 ayakhanyiswa imizuzwana embalwa: izivikelo ziyawabona, futhi amaqhawe akhanyisiwe athola umonakalo owengeziwe. Uma usukhanyise othile, umugqa uqobo awusafihlekile.

progression.buildingCatalog.rain_barrel_.en: Douses fire and rinses venom: burning and poison on buildings within 2.5 tiles end after 1 second, and firebomb splash there is 25% smaller. Wet ground conducts lightning, though.
progression.buildingCatalog.rain_barrel_.text: Licima umlilo futhi ligeze ubuthi: ukusha nobuthi ezakhiweni ezingaphakathi kwamathayela angu-2.5 kuphela ngemuva komzuzwana ongu-1, futhi ukusabalala kwamabhomu omlilo lapho kuncane ngo-25%. Kodwa umhlabathi omanzi uhambisa umbani.

progression.buildingCatalog.listening_ja.en: Buried clay jars that amplify every sound underfoot. Diggers within 3 tiles are forced to the surface and stunned for 1 second; unseen walkers within 2 tiles are revealed.
progression.buildingCatalog.listening_ja.text: Izimbiza zobumba ezigqitshiwe ezikhulisa yonke imisindo ngaphansi kwezinyawo. Abambayo abangaphakathi kwamathayela angu-3 baphoqeleka ukuphumela phezulu futhi bayadidizeliswa umzuzwana ongu-1; abahambi abangabonakali abangaphakathi kwamathayela angu-2 bayadalulwa.

progression.buildingCatalog.living_bambo.en: A wall that grows back 3% of its health every second and is too springy to climb. Wall-breaking multipliers count half (a 4x ram hits for 2.5x).
progression.buildingCatalog.living_bambo.text: Udonga olubuyisa u-3% wempilo yalo njalo ngomzuzwana futhi oluthambile kakhulu ukuba lugibelwe. Izandisi zokuqhekeza izindonga zibalwa ngengxenye (isigxobo sokushayisa esiphindwe ka-4 sishaya ngo-2.5).

progression.buildingCatalog.clockwork_re.en: A mechanic's crane that reaches over nearby defenses: jams, stuns and a Hawk Tamer's slowing on defenses within 3 tiles are cut short. A few repairs per battle.
progression.buildingCatalog.clockwork_re.text: Ikhreyini kamakhenikha efinyelela phezu kwezivikelo eziseduze: ukumiswa, ukudidizeliswa nokwehliswa ijubane nguMfuyi Wezinkozi ezivikelweni ezingaphakathi kwamathayela angu-3 kuyanqanyulwa. Ukulungisa okumbalwa ngempi ngayinye.

progression.buildingCatalog.bitter_incen.en: Burns bitter herbs: warriors within 3 tiles receive less healing, and healing, haste and toughness auras and shelter shields work at reduced strength on them.
progression.buildingCatalog.bitter_incen.text: Sishisa amakhambi ababayo: amaqhawe angaphakathi kwamathayela angu-3 athola ukwelashwa okuncane, futhi izinsizakuqinisa zokwelapha, ijubane nokuqina kanye nezihlangu zokukhosela zisebenza ngamandla ancishisiwe kuwo.

progression.buildingCatalog.straw_scarec.en: Animals cannot resist it, and birds are terrified of it. Beasts, their companions and charging mounts within 3 tiles must attack it first, and crane gliders swerve away from it. Lots of health, no damage, very flammable.
progression.buildingCatalog.straw_scarec.text: Izilwane azikwazi ukumelana nakho, futhi izinyoni zesaba kakhulu. Izilwane, abangane bazo nezilwane ezigijima ngamandla ezingaphakathi kwamathayela angu-3 kufanele zikuhlasele kuqala, futhi abandizi abangamahlolamvula bayaphambuka kukho. Impilo eningi, awunawo umonakalo, kusha kalula kakhulu.

progression.buildingCatalog.mirror_scree.en: Polished bronze panels: every third projectile that hits the screen flies back at whoever threw it. Melee warriors just walk up and smash it.
progression.buildingCatalog.mirror_scree.text: Amaphaneli ethusi apholishiwe: yonke into yesithathu ejikijelwayo eshaya isikrini ibuyela kulowo oyijikijele. Amaqhawe alwa eduze avele asondele bese ayasiphihliza.

progression.buildingCatalog.sand_bucket_.en: A bucket crew that smothers explosions and embers: splash damage within 3 tiles is 30% smaller, and they defuse up to two planted charges per battle.
progression.buildingCatalog.sand_bucket_.text: Iqembu lamabhakede elicima ukuqhuma namalahle: umonakalo osabalalayo ongaphakathi kwamathayela angu-3 uncane ngo-30%, futhi lingaqeda amabhomu atshaliwe afika kwamabili ngempi ngayinye.

progression.buildingCatalog.kite_cutter_.en: Air only. Fires a spinning bolas that tangles anything with wings or strings: a flyer it hits is grounded for 3 seconds, where ground defenses can reach it. A flyer that breaks free can't be tangled again for 3 seconds.
progression.buildingCatalog.kite_cutter_.text: Emoyeni kuphela. Sidubula intambo enamatshe ezungezayo ethandela noma yini enamaphiko noma izintambo: indizayo eshaywe yiyo yehliselwa phansi imizuzwana engu-3, lapho izivikelo zasemhlabathini zingayifinyelela. Indizayo ezikhululayo ayinakuthandelwa futhi imizuzwana engu-3.

progression.buildingCatalog.discipline_b.en: A clan banner that keeps nearby defenders focused: defenses within 3 tiles ignore taunting bells and decoys.
progression.buildingCatalog.discipline_b.text: Ifulegi lesizwe eligcina abavikeli abaseduze begxile: izivikelo ezingaphakathi kwamathayela angu-3 azinaki izinsimbi ezihehayo nezinto zokukhohlisa.

progression.buildingCatalog.spotter_perc.en: A lookout who calls targets: defenses within 3 tiles retarget instantly onto warriors that dash, swing or shadow-step into range.
progression.buildingCatalog.spotter_perc.text: Umlindi omemeza okuhlosiwe: izivikelo ezingaphakathi kwamathayela angu-3 ziphendukela ngokushesha kumaqhawe agijima, ajikayo noma angena ebangeni ngesinyathelo sesithunzi.

progression.buildingCatalog.steam_vent.d.en: Blasts scalding steam in a 2-tile circle. It needs no target, so it hurts hidden warriors, blows smoke away from its tiles, and cannot be dodged.
progression.buildingCatalog.steam_vent.d.text: Iqhumisa isisi esishisa kakhulu esiyindilinga yamathayela angu-2. Ayidingi okuhlosiwe, ngakho ilimaza amaqhawe afihlekile, iphephula intuthu emathayeleni ayo, futhi ayinakugwenywa.

progression.buildingCatalog.sleep_dart_t.en: Darts that barely scratch but put a warrior to sleep for 2 seconds. The same warrior can only be put to sleep once. Best against a few big fighters.
progression.buildingCatalog.sleep_dart_t.text: Imicibisholo emincane eklwebha kancane kodwa elalisa iqhawe imizuzwana engu-2. Iqhawe elifanayo lingalaliswa kanye kuphela. Kungcono kakhulu kubalwi abambalwa abakhulu.

progression.buildingCatalog.rolling_log_.en: Releases a log down a 1-tile lane: heavy damage to every ground warrior in the line. It is not splash, so tower shields do not stop it. Punishes clumped buff squads.
progression.buildingCatalog.rolling_log_.text: Ikhulula ugodo ehlehlela emzileni ongange-thayela elilodwa: umonakalo omkhulu kuwo wonke amaqhawe asemhlabathini asemugqeni. Akukhona ukusabalala, ngakho izihlangu zombhoshongo azikumisi. Kujezisa amaqembu aqinisiwe aqoqene.

progression.buildingCatalog.moonlit_grav.en: Raked gravel that crunches: anything that teleports, lands or rushes onto it is stunned for 1.5 seconds.
progression.buildingCatalog.moonlit_grav.text: Amatshana ahlwathiwe aqhasha: noma yini edluliselwa ngomlingo, ehlela noma egijimela phezu kwawo iyadidizeliswa imizuzwana engu-1.5.

progression.buildingCatalog.ink_seal_pos.en: Warriors who fall within 3 tiles are sealed in ink: they cannot be revived, and nothing bails out of them.
progression.buildingCatalog.ink_seal_pos.text: Amaqhawe awela ngaphakathi kwamathayela angu-3 avalwa ngoyinki: awakwazi ukuvuselelwa, futhi akukho okuphuma kuwo.

progression.buildingCatalog.longbow_yagu.en: A tall archery tower with range 13 that outranges every siege warrior. It prefers warriors attacking from 3.5 tiles or more (throwers and artillery), but cannot hit anything closer than 2 tiles.
progression.buildingCatalog.longbow_yagu.text: Umbhoshongo omude wokucibishela onebanga elingu-13 elidlula lawo wonke amaqhawe okuvimbezela. Ikhetha amaqhawe ahlasela kusukela kumathayela angu-3.5 noma ngaphezulu (abajikijeli nezibhamu ezinkulu), kodwa ayikwazi ukushaya noma yini esondele ngaphansi kwamathayela angu-2.

progression.buildingCatalog.lightning_ro.en: Grounds lightning: chained slashes and lightning strikes within 3 tiles hit the rod instead, charging it. When fully charged it fires the lightning back.
progression.buildingCatalog.lightning_ro.text: Uhambisa umbani emhlabathini: ukusika okuxhumene nemibani engaphakathi kwamathayela angu-3 kushaya induku esikhundleni, kuyishaje. Uma isishajwe ngokuphelele, ibuyisela umbani.

roster.warriors.shinobi.ability.text.en: Cheap and fast; the first warrior every clan trains.
roster.warriors.shinobi.ability.text.text: Ushibhile futhi uyashesha; iqhawe lokuqala esiqeqeshwa yisizwe ngasinye.

roster.warriors.twin_fang_dancer.ability.en: Every hit lands twice, on its target and the next building beside it.
roster.warriors.twin_fang_dancer.ability.text: Konke ukushaya kwenzeka kabili, kokuhlosiwe nakwisakhiwo esilandelayo esiseduze kwakho.

roster.warriors.wind_step_assassin.abili.en: Dashes to a new target; the first hit after each dash deals double damage.
roster.warriors.wind_step_assassin.abili.text: Ugijimela kokuhlosiwe okusha; ukushaya kokuqala ngemuva kokugijima ngakunye kwenza umonakalo ophindwe kabili.

roster.warriors.moonblade_master.ability.en: Every fourth strike is a crescent slash for 2.5x damage.
roster.warriors.moonblade_master.ability.text: Njalo ukushaya kwesine kuwukusika okuyinyanga encane okunomonakalo ophindwe ka-2.5.

roster.warriors.storm_sovereign.ability..en: Slashes arc between up to three nearby buildings.
roster.warriors.storm_sovereign.ability..text: Ukusika kweqa phakathi kwezakhiwo ezingafika kwezintathu eziseduze.

roster.warriors.kunai_adept.ability.text.en: Fragile ranged damage from behind the front line.
roster.warriors.kunai_adept.ability.text.text: Umonakalo wasebangeni obuthakathaka ovela ngemuva komugqa wangaphambili.

roster.warriors.shuriken_storm.ability.t.en: Throws three shuriken at once; small splash.
roster.warriors.shuriken_storm.ability.t.text: Ujikijela ama-shuriken amathathu ngesikhathi esisodwa; ukusabalala okuncane.

roster.warriors.blowgun_hunter.ability.t.en: Darts keep damaging a building for 5 seconds.
roster.warriors.blowgun_hunter.ability.t.text: Imicibisholo iqhubeka ilimaza isakhiwo imizuzwana engu-5.

roster.warriors.chain_sickle_reaper.abil.en: Hits make the target take 20% more damage from everyone.
roster.warriors.chain_sickle_reaper.abil.text: Ukushaya kwenza okuhlosiwe kuthole umonakalo owengeziwe ongu-20% kuwo wonke umuntu.

roster.warriors.thousand_needle.ability..en: Very long range and rapid fire; must stay behind cover.
roster.warriors.thousand_needle.ability..text: Ibanga elide kakhulu nokudubula okusheshayo; kumele ahlale ngemuva kwesivikelo.

roster.warriors.armored_guardian.ability.en: Walks straight into defenses and soaks their fire.
roster.warriors.armored_guardian.ability.text: Ungena ngqo ezivikelweni futhi amunce umlilo wazo.

roster.warriors.iron_monk.ability.text.en: Warriors beside him take 15% less damage.
roster.warriors.iron_monk.ability.text.text: Amaqhawe aseduze kwayo athola umonakalo omncane ngo-15%.

roster.warriors.bell_warden.ability.text.en: Rings a bell that makes defenses in range target him first.
roster.warriors.bell_warden.ability.text.text: Ushaya insimbi eyenza izivikelo ezisebangeni zimhlasele yena kuqala.

roster.warriors.mountain_shield.ability..en: Carries a tower shield that absorbs splash for allies behind him.
roster.warriors.mountain_shield.ability..text: Uphethe isihlangu esikhulu esimunca ukusabalala kwabangane abangemuva kwakhe.

roster.warriors.oni_breaker.ability.text.en: Huge health; smashes walls for five times damage.
roster.warriors.oni_breaker.ability.text.text: Impilo enkulu kakhulu; uphihliza izindonga ngomonakalo ophindwe kahlanu.

roster.warriors.saboteur.ability.text.en: Jams the nearest working defense for 6 seconds (once per Saboteur).
roster.warriors.saboteur.ability.text.text: Umisa isivikelo esisebenzayo esiseduze kakhulu imizuzwana engu-6 (kanye kuMonakalisi ngamunye).

roster.warriors.trap_breaker.ability.tex.en: Finds and disarms hidden traps along the squad's path.
roster.warriors.trap_breaker.ability.tex.text: Uthola futhi aqede izicupho ezifihlekile endleleni yeqembu.

roster.warriors.gearbreaker.ability.text.en: Two jams per warrior, each lasting 9 seconds.
roster.warriors.gearbreaker.ability.text.text: Ukumisa okubili ngeqhawe ngalinye, ngakunye kuthatha imizuzwana engu-9.

roster.warriors.fuse_master.ability.text.en: Plants a charge on a defense that explodes after 5 seconds.
roster.warriors.fuse_master.ability.text.text: Utshala ibhomu esivikelweni eliqhuma ngemuva kwemizuzwana engu-5.

roster.warriors.ghost_engineer.ability.t.en: Once per battle, jams up to three defenses within 3 tiles for 4 seconds. Shares jam immunity with other specialists.
roster.warriors.ghost_engineer.ability.t.text: Kanye ngempi, umisa izivikelo ezingafika kwezintathu ezingaphakathi kwamathayela angu-3 imizuzwana engu-4. Wabelana ngokungathinteki ekumisweni nabanye ochwepheshe.

roster.warriors.tunnel_runner.ability.te.en: Digs under walls to reach any building.
roster.warriors.tunnel_runner.ability.te.text: Umba ngaphansi kwezindonga ukuze afike kunoma yisiphi isakhiwo.

roster.warriors.wall_climber.ability.tex.en: Climbs over walls and goes for storehouses first.
roster.warriors.wall_climber.ability.tex.text: Ugibela phezu kwezindonga futhi aqale ngezinqolobane.

roster.warriors.grapple_raider.ability.t.en: Swings over walls straight to the nearest defense.
roster.warriors.grapple_raider.ability.t.text: Uzulazula phezu kwezindonga aye ngqo esivikelweni esiseduze kakhulu.

roster.warriors.mole_king.ability.text.en: Bursts out of the ground beside a defense, stunning it for 2 seconds.
roster.warriors.mole_king.ability.text.text: Uqhuma aphume emhlabathini eduze kwesivikelo, asididizelise imizuzwana engu-2.

roster.warriors.phantom_gate.ability.tex.en: Walls near it crumble, opening a path for everyone.
roster.warriors.phantom_gate.ability.tex.text: Izindonga eziseduze kwaso ziyawohloka, zivulele wonke umuntu indlela.

roster.warriors.kite_raider.ability.text.en: Glides over walls on a war kite and bombs defenses.
roster.warriors.kite_raider.ability.text.text: Undiza phezu kwezindonga ngekhayithi lempi futhi aqhumise izivikelo.

roster.warriors.crane_glider.ability.tex.en: Very fast flyer that raids storehouses.

roster.warriors.lantern_balloon.ability..en: Slow balloon that drops burning embers in a wide area.
roster.warriors.lantern_balloon.ability..text: Ibhaluni elihamba kancane eliwisa amalahle avuthayo endaweni ebanzi.

roster.warriors.thunder_kite.ability.tex.en: Lightning hits a defense and up to three nearby defenses for 35% damage each.
roster.warriors.thunder_kite.ability.tex.text: Umbani ushaya isivikelo kanye nezivikelo ezingafika kwezintathu eziseduze, ngomonakalo ongu-35% kuso ngasinye.

roster.warriors.dragon_kite_armada.abili.en: A heavy dragon kite carrying a crew of bombers.
roster.warriors.dragon_kite_armada.abili.text: Ikhayithi likadrako elisindayo elithwele iqembu labaqhumisi.

roster.warriors.drum_monk.ability.text.en: Nearby warriors move and attack 25% faster within 3 tiles. Multiple drums do not stack.
roster.warriors.drum_monk.ability.text.text: Amaqhawe aseduze ahamba futhi ahlasele ngokushesha ngo-25% ngaphakathi kwamathayela angu-3. Izigubhu eziningi azihlangani.

roster.warriors.mist_weaver.ability.text.en: Wraps nearby warriors in thin mist (a small moving smoke cloud).
roster.warriors.mist_weaver.ability.text.text: Usonga amaqhawe aseduze ngenkungu encane (ifu elincane lentuthu elihambayo).

roster.warriors.spirit_caller.ability.te.en: Brings one fallen warrior back to its feet.
roster.warriors.spirit_caller.ability.te.text: Uvusa iqhawe elilodwa eliwile limi ngezinyawo futhi.

roster.warriors.sage_of_clouds.ability.t.en: Once per battle, heals nearby warriors for 25% and grants a 4-second, one-hit shield (blocks up to half their maximum health). Shields cannot be refreshed for 10 seconds.
roster.warriors.sage_of_clouds.ability.t.text: Kanye ngempi, welapha amaqhawe aseduze ngo-25% futhi uwanika isihlangu semizuzwana engu-4 esivimba ukushaya okukodwa (sivimba kuze kube yingxenye yempilo yawo ephezulu). Izihlangu azikwazi ukuvuselelwa imizuzwana engu-10.

roster.warriors.ram_crew.ability.text.en: Four times damage against walls and gates.

roster.warriors.fire_monk.ability.text.en: Short-range fire that burns a small area of buildings.
roster.warriors.fire_monk.ability.text.text: Umlilo webanga elifushane oshisa indawo encane yezakhiwo.

roster.warriors.bomb_carrier.ability.tex.en: Runs to the nearest wall or defense and explodes.
roster.warriors.bomb_carrier.ability.tex.text: Ugijimela odongeni noma esivikelweni esiseduze kakhulu bese eyaqhuma.

roster.warriors.siege_bombardier.ability.en: Artillery with 5-tile range that fires on defenses. Stops to fire every 2.5 seconds; vulnerable while approaching and cannot move while firing.
roster.warriors.siege_bombardier.ability.text: Isibhamu esikhulu esinebanga lamathayela angu-5 esidubula izivikelo. Uma ukudubula njalo ngemizuzwana engu-2.5; usengozini ngenkathi esondela futhi akakwazi ukuhamba ngenkathi edubula.

roster.warriors.volcano_cannoneer.abilit.en: Huge splash that leaves burning ground.
roster.warriors.volcano_cannoneer.abilit.text: Ukusabalala okukhulu kakhulu okushiya umhlabathi uvutha.

roster.warriors.hound_handler.ability.te.en: Fights alongside two hunting dogs. The handler and dogs share one health and damage budget.
roster.warriors.hound_handler.ability.te.text: Ulwa nezinja ezimbili zokuzingela. Umfuyi nezinja babelana ngempilo eyodwa nomonakalo owodwa.

roster.warriors.hawk_tamer.ability.text.en: Her hawk harries a defense from range, slowing its fire.
roster.warriors.hawk_tamer.ability.text.text: Ukhozi lwakhe luhlupha isivikelo lusekude, lwehlise ijubane lokudubula kwaso.

roster.warriors.boar_rider.ability.text.en: Charges through the first wall in its way.
roster.warriors.boar_rider.ability.text.text: Ugijima ngamandla adabule udonga lokuqala endleleni yakhe.

roster.warriors.bear_warrior.ability.tex.en: Hits much harder below half health.
roster.warriors.bear_warrior.ability.tex.text: Ushaya kakhulu uma impilo yakhe ingaphansi kwengxenye.

roster.warriors.tiger_lord.ability.text.en: Arrives with two war tigers. Rider and tigers share one health and damage budget.
roster.warriors.tiger_lord.ability.text.text: Ufika nezingwe ezimbili zempi. Umgibeli nezingwe babelana ngempilo eyodwa nomonakalo owodwa.

roster.warriors.shadow_stalker.ability.t.en: Cannot be targeted until it attacks for the first time.

roster.warriors.mirage_twin.ability.text.en: Leaves a decoy that draws fire for 4 seconds.
roster.warriors.mirage_twin.ability.text.text: Ushiya inkohliso edonsa umlilo imizuzwana engu-4.

roster.warriors.night_blade.ability.text.en: Deals double damage to buildings inside smoke.
roster.warriors.night_blade.ability.text.text: Wenza umonakalo ophindwe kabili ezakhiweni ezingaphakathi kwentuthu.

roster.warriors.void_walker.ability.text.en: Steps through shadows straight onto its target.
roster.warriors.void_walker.ability.text.text: Unyathela phakathi kwezithunzi aye ngqo kokuhlosiwe.

roster.warriors.eclipse_ninja.ability.te.en: Unseen until its first attack, immune to traps, and has a 25% chance of double damage on each hit.
roster.warriors.eclipse_ninja.ability.te.text: Akabonakali aze ahlasele okokuqala, akathinteki ezicuphweni, futhi unethuba elingu-25% lomonakalo ophindwe kabili kukho konke ukushaya.

roster.heroes.shadow_captain.ability.tex.en: Nearby warriors fight 30% harder for 8 seconds. Recharges each battle.
roster.heroes.shadow_captain.ability.tex.text: Amaqhawe aseduze alwa ngamandla angu-30% engeziwe imizuzwana engu-8. Iyashajwa kabusha empini ngayinye.

roster.heroes.iron_matriarch.ability.tex.en: Raises a wall of shields that blocks defense fire in a cone for 6 seconds.
roster.heroes.iron_matriarch.ability.tex.text: Uphakamisa udonga lwezihlangu oluvimba umlilo wezivikelo endaweni emise okwekhoni imizuzwana engu-6.

roster.heroes.sky_admiral.ability.text.en: Pushes all flyers forward and shields them from anti-air for 5 seconds.
roster.heroes.sky_admiral.ability.text.text: Uphushela phambili bonke abandizayo futhi abavikele ezivikelweni zasemoyeni imizuzwana engu-5.

roster.heroes.grand_sensei.ability.text.en: Every warrior on the field heals 40% and ignores the next jam, trap or splash.
roster.heroes.grand_sensei.ability.text.text: Wonke amaqhawe asenkundleni elashwa ngo-40% futhi angakunaki ukumiswa, isicupho noma ukusabalala okulandelayo.

social.chatLines.random.1.en: The terraced farms look great after the rain.
social.chatLines.random.1.text: Amasimu anezitebhisi abukeka kahle ngemuva kwemvula.

social.chatLines.random.3.en: Who wants to raid together later?

social.chatLines.random.4.en: My artisans never sleep, I swear.

social.chatLines.random.5.en: Good luck on your upgrades today!

social.chatLines.random.6.en: The Stone Lanterns look so calm at night.
social.chatLines.random.6.text: Amalambu Etshe abukeka ethule kakhulu ebusuku.

social.chatLines.random.8.en: Almost three-starred a fortress just now!
social.chatLines.random.8.text: Ngicishe ngathola izinkanyezi ezintathu enqabeni manje!

social.chatLines.random.9.en: Shinobi rush is underrated. Fight me.
social.chatLines.random.9.text: Ukugijima kwama-Shinobi akunakwa ngokwanele. Ngiphikise uma uthanda.

social.chatLines.random.10.en: Smoke first, then send everything. Works every time.
social.chatLines.random.10.text: Intuthu kuqala, bese uthumela konke. Kusebenza njalo.

social.chatLines.random.11.en: Upgrading my Clan Keep, see you in a day!

social.chatLines.random.12.en: Back from a raid with full storehouses!

social.chatLines.random.13.en: Saboteurs on the mortar, then guardians in. Clean.
social.chatLines.random.13.text: Abonakalisi enganonweni, bese abavikeli bangena. Kuhlanzekile.

social.chatLines.random.14.en: Who has the tidiest village here?
social.chatLines.random.14.text: Ubani onesigodi esihleleke kahle kakhulu lapha?

social.chatLines.random.15.en: Meditating for a bit, guard my village!

social.chatLines.greet.1.en: Welcome, new ally! Glad to have you.
social.chatLines.greet.1.text: Siyakwamukela, mngane omusha! Siyajabula ukuba nawe.

social.chatLines.greet.2.en: Welcome! Ask if you need warriors.

social.chatLines.greet.3.en: A new blade joins us. Welcome!

social.chatLines.raidStart.0.en: Alliance War has started! Use both your attacks!
social.chatLines.raidStart.0.text: Impi Yomfelandawonye iqalile! Sebenzisa kokubili ukuhlasela kwakho!

social.chatLines.raidStart.1.en: Time to raid! Go for the stars!

social.chatLines.raidStart.2.en: Alliance War is on, good luck everyone!
social.chatLines.raidStart.2.text: Impi Yomfelandawonye iyaqhubeka, inhlanhla enhle kubo bonke!

social.chatLines.raidEnd.1.en: That was fun! Same time next week?

trials.modifiers.elite.description.en: Defenses are 20% tougher and hit 20% harder.
trials.modifiers.elite.description.text: Izivikelo ziqine ngo-20% futhi zishaya ngamandla angu-20% engeziwe.

troops.hedgehog_roller.description.en: Fast, cheap melee fighter. Dashes to the nearest building.
troops.hedgehog_roller.description.text: Umlwi oseduze osheshayo noshibhile. Ugijimela esakhiweni esiseduze kakhulu.

troops.frog_lobber.description.en: Throws kunai from a distance. Fragile, so keep it behind sturdier warriors.
troops.frog_lobber.description.text: Ujikijela ama-kunai esekude. Buthakathaka, ngakho mgcine ngemuva kwamaqhawe aqinile.

troops.beetle_brute.description.en: A heavily armored frontliner who marches straight for defenses and soaks up their fire.
troops.beetle_brute.description.text: Umlwi wangaphambili onezembatho ezisindayo omasha ngqo eziya ezivikelweni futhi amunce umlilo wazo.

troops.owl_bomber.description.en: Glides over walls on a war kite and drops firebombs on defenses. Sky Bow Towers, Shuriken Towers and the Kite-Cutter Ballista can hit it.
troops.owl_bomber.description.text: Undiza phezu kwezindonga ngekhayithi lempi futhi awisele amabhomu omlilo ezivikelweni. Imibhoshongo Yomnsalo Wesibhakabhaka, Imibhoshongo We-Shuriken kanye Nesibhamu Esisika Amakhayithi kungamshaya.

troops.mole_digger.description.en: Digs under walls to reach any building.
troops.mole_digger.description.text: Umba ngaphansi kwezindonga ukuze afike kunoma yisiphi isakhiwo.

troops.saboteur.description.en: Grapples over walls to the nearest working defense and jams it for 6 seconds. One jam per Saboteur; afterwards it fights weakly. A jammed defense can't be jammed again until 10 seconds after it recovers.
troops.saboteur.description.text: Ugibela phezu kwezindonga ngehuku aye esivikelweni esisebenzayo esiseduze kakhulu futhi asimise imizuzwana engu-6. Ukumisa okukodwa kuMonakalisi ngamunye; ngemuva kwalokho ulwa kabuthakathaka. Isivikelo esimisiwe asinakumiswa futhi kuze kudlule imizuzwana engu-10 ngemuva kokuba sisebenze futhi.

troops.twin_fang_dancer.description.en: Every hit lands twice, on its target and the next building beside it.
troops.twin_fang_dancer.description.text: Konke ukushaya kwenzeka kabili, kokuhlosiwe nakwisakhiwo esilandelayo esiseduze kwakho.

troops.wind_step_assassin.description.text: Ugijimela kokuhlosiwe okusha; ukushaya kokuqala ngemuva kokugijima ngakunye kwenza umonakalo ophindwe kabili.

troops.moonblade_master.description.en: Every fourth strike is a crescent slash for 2.5x damage.
troops.moonblade_master.description.text: Njalo ukushaya kwesine kuwukusika okuyinyanga encane okunomonakalo ophindwe ka-2.5.

troops.storm_sovereign.description.en: Slashes arc between up to three nearby buildings.
troops.storm_sovereign.description.text: Ukusika kweqa phakathi kwezakhiwo ezingafika kwezintathu eziseduze.

troops.shuriken_storm.description.en: Throws three shuriken at once; small splash.
troops.shuriken_storm.description.text: Ujikijela ama-shuriken amathathu ngesikhathi esisodwa; ukusabalala okuncane.

troops.blowgun_hunter.description.text: Imicibisholo iqhubeka ilimaza isakhiwo imizuzwana engu-5.

troops.chain_sickle_reaper.description.text: Ukushaya kwenza okuhlosiwe kuthole umonakalo owengeziwe ongu-20% kuwo wonke umuntu.

troops.thousand_needle.description.text: Ibanga elide (amathayela angu-5) nokudubula okusheshayo; kumele ahlale ngemuva kwesivikelo.

troops.iron_monk.description.en: Warriors beside him take 15% less damage.
troops.iron_monk.description.text: Amaqhawe aseduze kwayo athola umonakalo omncane ngo-15%.

troops.bell_warden.description.en: Rings a bell that makes defenses in range target him first.
troops.bell_warden.description.text: Ushaya insimbi eyenza izivikelo ezisebangeni zimhlasele yena kuqala.

troops.mountain_shield.description.en: Carries a tower shield that absorbs splash for allies behind him.
troops.mountain_shield.description.text: Uphethe isihlangu esikhulu esimunca ukusabalala kwabangane abangemuva kwakhe.

troops.oni_breaker.description.en: Huge health; smashes walls for five times damage.
troops.oni_breaker.description.text: Impilo enkulu kakhulu; uphihliza izindonga ngomonakalo ophindwe kahlanu.

troops.trap_breaker.description.en: Finds and disarms hidden traps along the squad's path.
troops.trap_breaker.description.text: Uthola futhi aqede izicupho ezifihlekile endleleni yeqembu.

troops.gearbreaker.description.en: Two jams per warrior, each lasting 9 seconds.
troops.gearbreaker.description.text: Ukumisa okubili ngeqhawe ngalinye, ngakunye kuthatha imizuzwana engu-9.

troops.fuse_master.description.en: Plants a charge on a defense that explodes after 5 seconds.
troops.fuse_master.description.text: Utshala ibhomu esivikelweni eliqhuma ngemuva kwemizuzwana engu-5.

troops.ghost_engineer.description.en: Once per battle, jams up to three defenses within 3 tiles for 4 seconds. Shares jam immunity with other specialists.
troops.ghost_engineer.description.text: Kanye ngempi, umisa izivikelo ezingafika kwezintathu ezingaphakathi kwamathayela angu-3 imizuzwana engu-4. Wabelana ngokungathinteki ekumisweni nabanye ochwepheshe.

troops.wall_climber.description.en: Climbs over walls and goes for storehouses first.
troops.wall_climber.description.text: Ugibela phezu kwezindonga futhi aqale ngezinqolobane.

troops.grapple_raider.description.en: Swings over walls straight to the nearest defense.
troops.grapple_raider.description.text: Uzulazula phezu kwezindonga aye ngqo esivikelweni esiseduze kakhulu.

troops.mole_king.description.en: Bursts out of the ground beside a defense, stunning it for 2 seconds.
troops.mole_king.description.text: Uqhuma aphume emhlabathini eduze kwesivikelo, asididizelise imizuzwana engu-2.

troops.phantom_gate.description.en: Walls near it crumble, opening a path for everyone.
troops.phantom_gate.description.text: Izindonga eziseduze kwaso ziyawohloka, zivulele wonke umuntu indlela.

troops.crane_glider.description.en: Very fast flyer that raids storehouses.

troops.lantern_balloon.description.en: Slow balloon that drops burning embers in a wide area.
troops.lantern_balloon.description.text: Ibhaluni elihamba kancane eliwisa amalahle avuthayo endaweni ebanzi.

troops.thunder_kite.description.en: Lightning hits a defense and up to three nearby defenses for 35% damage each.
troops.thunder_kite.description.text: Umbani ushaya isivikelo kanye nezivikelo ezingafika kwezintathu eziseduze, ngomonakalo ongu-35% kuso ngasinye.

troops.dragon_kite_armada.description.en: A heavy dragon kite carrying a crew of bombers.
troops.dragon_kite_armada.description.text: Ikhayithi likadrako elisindayo elithwele iqembu labaqhumisi.

troops.drum_monk.description.en: Nearby warriors move and attack 25% faster within 3 tiles. Multiple drums do not stack.
troops.drum_monk.description.text: Amaqhawe aseduze ahamba futhi ahlasele ngokushesha ngo-25% ngaphakathi kwamathayela angu-3. Izigubhu eziningi azihlangani.

troops.mist_weaver.description.en: Wraps nearby warriors in thin mist (a small moving smoke cloud).
troops.mist_weaver.description.text: Usonga amaqhawe aseduze ngenkungu encane (ifu elincane lentuthu elihambayo).

troops.spirit_caller.description.en: Brings one fallen warrior back to its feet.
troops.spirit_caller.description.text: Uvusa iqhawe elilodwa eliwile limi ngezinyawo futhi.

troops.sage_of_clouds.description.en: Once per battle, heals nearby warriors for 25% and grants a 4-second, one-hit shield (blocks up to half their maximum health). Shields cannot be refreshed for 10 seconds.
troops.sage_of_clouds.description.text: Kanye ngempi, welapha amaqhawe aseduze ngo-25% futhi uwanika isihlangu semizuzwana engu-4 esivimba ukushaya okukodwa (sivimba kuze kube yingxenye yempilo yawo ephezulu). Izihlangu azikwazi ukuvuselelwa imizuzwana engu-10.

troops.ram_crew.description.en: Four times damage against walls and gates.

troops.fire_monk.description.en: Short-range fire that burns a small area of buildings.
troops.fire_monk.description.text: Umlilo webanga elifushane oshisa indawo encane yezakhiwo.

troops.bomb_carrier.description.en: Runs to the nearest wall or defense and explodes.
troops.bomb_carrier.description.text: Ugijimela odongeni noma esivikelweni esiseduze kakhulu bese eyaqhuma.

troops.siege_bombardier.description.en: Artillery with 5-tile range that fires on defenses. Stops to fire every 2.5 seconds; still inside a Kunai Tower's reach, and a Longbow Yagura hunts it.
troops.siege_bombardier.description.text: Isibhamu esikhulu esinebanga lamathayela angu-5 esidubula izivikelo. Uma ukudubula njalo ngemizuzwana engu-2.5; usesebangeni loMbhoshongo We-Kunai, futhi i-Yagura Yomnsalo Omude iyamzingela.

troops.volcano_cannoneer.description.en: Huge splash that leaves burning ground.
troops.volcano_cannoneer.description.text: Ukusabalala okukhulu kakhulu okushiya umhlabathi uvutha.

troops.hound_handler.description.en: Fights alongside two hunting dogs. The handler and dogs share one health and damage budget.
troops.hound_handler.description.text: Ulwa nezinja ezimbili zokuzingela. Umfuyi nezinja babelana ngempilo eyodwa nomonakalo owodwa.

troops.hawk_tamer.description.en: Her hawk harries a defense from range, slowing its fire.
troops.hawk_tamer.description.text: Ukhozi lwakhe luhlupha isivikelo lusekude, lwehlise ijubane lokudubula kwaso.

troops.boar_rider.description.en: Charges through the first wall in its way.
troops.boar_rider.description.text: Ugijima ngamandla adabule udonga lokuqala endleleni yakhe.

troops.bear_warrior.description.en: Hits much harder below half health.
troops.bear_warrior.description.text: Ushaya kakhulu uma impilo yakhe ingaphansi kwengxenye.

troops.tiger_lord.description.en: Arrives with two war tigers. Rider and tigers share one health and damage budget.
troops.tiger_lord.description.text: Ufika nezingwe ezimbili zempi. Umgibeli nezingwe babelana ngempilo eyodwa nomonakalo owodwa.

troops.shadow_stalker.description.en: Cannot be targeted until it attacks for the first time.

troops.mirage_twin.description.en: Leaves a decoy that draws fire for 4 seconds.
troops.mirage_twin.description.text: Ushiya inkohliso edonsa umlilo imizuzwana engu-4.

troops.night_blade.description.en: Deals double damage to buildings inside smoke.
troops.night_blade.description.text: Wenza umonakalo ophindwe kabili ezakhiweni ezingaphakathi kwentuthu.

troops.void_walker.description.en: Steps through shadows straight onto its target.
troops.void_walker.description.text: Unyathela phakathi kwezithunzi aye ngqo kokuhlosiwe.

troops.eclipse_ninja.description.en: Unseen until its first attack, immune to traps, and has a 25% chance of double damage on each hit.
troops.eclipse_ninja.description.text: Akabonakali aze ahlasele okokuqala, akathinteki ezicuphweni, futhi unethuba elingu-25% lomonakalo ophindwe kabili kukho konke ukushaya.
